description.value:
Your enemies will fall to their knees before you... after you blow off their feet.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Snubnose Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 18 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Smart Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 2 rounds in a burst. If there are not 2 rounds left in the magazine, Single Shot expends the entire magazine. Can only load modified Improved Smart Ammunition (100eb [Premium] per 10 rounds) which also functions as Armor-Piercing. When rolling for damage with this weapon, 5s count as 6s for the purposes of incurring Critical Injuries. When this weapon inflicts a Critical Injury, the user rolls three times on the Critical Injury table, re-rolling any repeats, and chooses one result for the victim to suffer. This weapon can be reloaded without an Action by sacrificing the user's Move Action as long as they have at least one other open hand.

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Snubnose Pistol
Pre-installed: Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
